title: Purdue, GCCS partner to scale the future of silicon carbide
summary_en: Joint initiative targets critical thermal and power bottlenecks in global AI infrastructure

title: Collaboration Across Disciplines: The Grid of Tomorrow Consortium
summary_en: Researchers, including several from ASPIRE, have founded the Grid of Tomorrow Consortium (GoTC), headquartered at Purdue University, to provide this vital opportunity for multi-disciplinary problem-solving.
title_cn: Collaboration Across Disciplines: The Grid of Tomorrow Consortium

title: ECE's Badesha appointed as President's Fellow
summary_en: Santokh Badesha, Distinguished Professor in the Elmore Family School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, has been appointed as a President's Fellow in recognition of his numerous and continued professional accomplishments in idea generation, management and protection of intellectual property.
title_cn: ECE's Badesha appointed as President's Fellow

title: Purdue hosts national IoT4Ag retreat focused on the future of precision agriculture
summary_en: Purdue University welcomed university researchers, students, industry leaders and the grower community to the 2026 Annual Retreat of the Internet of Things for Precision Agriculture (IoT4Ag) from May 19-21 at the Beck Agricultural Center in West Lafayette and at regional farms in Indiana.
title_cn: Purdue hosts national IoT4Ag retreat focused on the future of precision agriculture
